/** * Shared form-field recipe for the Playdesk Base UI variant. * * Same material as the Radix variant: raised controls carry a gloss over a * vertical gradient (the --fill-* tokens), fields are recessed white wells. * Only the primitive library underneath differs. */ export const formFieldBase = "w-full rounded-lg px-3.5 text-sm " + "bg-input text-foreground " + "border border-border " + "placeholder:text-muted-foreground " + "transition-[color,box-shadow,border-color] duration-fast ease-out " + "[box-shadow:var(--shadow-inset)] " + "hover:border-foreground/20 " + "focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[0.1875rem] focus-visible:ring-ring/25 " + "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50" export const formFieldSingleLine = "flex h-10 py-2" export const formFieldMultiLine = "flex min-h-[5.5rem] py-2.5 resize-y" /* Floating surface: window rim plus the wide desk float. */ export const floatingSurface = "bg-popover text-popover-foreground rounded-lg [box-shadow:var(--shadow-rim),var(--shadow-float)]" /* Base UI passes a state object to className; the wrappers feed cn(), so the * prop is narrowed to a plain string throughout this variant. */ export type WithClassName

= Omit & { className?: string }
